items.financial_line_items_note: Trích xuất từ văn bản PDF/ZIP đã lưu; cần đối chiếu trực quan với báo cáo gốc. Tổng thuế được đối chiếu từ lợi nhuận trước thuế trừ lợi nhuận sau thuế. CASHFLOW NORMALIZATION 2026-10-29: CFO/CFI/CFF read from final lines 60/70/80, net movement from line 90, aggregate opening/closing cash from lines 101/103. Standalone quarter = selected YTD current minus prior quarter YTD. Source line 102/104 component adjustments are retained as raw metadata, not used as additive FX bridge. Values rounded from source VND to million VND; <=0.01% residuals accepted without changing values or adding balancing plugs; direct visual review remains pending.
